subject: Thanks for joining our webinar — quick demo?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightbank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for joining our webinar — quick demo?

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for joining today’s webinar on cost-aware LLM inference — really appreciate you taking the time. I saw you registered as part of BrightBank — would love to set up a short 30-minute demo to show how Redwood can help reduce inference cost while keeping latency predictable for customer-facing workflows.

A few quick times I have available this week (PDT):
- Wed 7/22 10:00–10:30am
- Wed 7/22 2:00–2:30pm
- Thu 7/23 9:30–10:00am

If none of those work, you can pick any open slot here: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

I’ve attached the webinar slides for reference — happy to tailor the demo to your main use case if you share a quick note on what you’re evaluating (embeddings for search, chat assistant, or routing/triage).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (510) 555-0143

Attachment: redwood-webinar-slides.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for joining our webinar — quick demo?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — the webinar was great. I’m Alex (Sr. Product Manager, BrightBank). The 2pm slot on Wed would work best for me but I’m on east coast hours (EST) so that’s actually 5pm for me. Can we aim for a morning PST time (which is afternoon for me) — anything around 10am PDT would be ideal.

Also want to loop in our security lead and a procurement contact for the later conversation; can we include them on the calendar invite if we proceed?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Sr. Product Manager, BrightBank
alex.johnson@brightbank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for joining our webinar — quick demo?

Hi Alex — great, thanks for the quick reply.

10:00am PDT on Wed 7/22 works on my end — I’ve tentatively held that. I’ll send a calendar invite to you and cc Rachel (our AE) so she can run the demo and handle next steps. If you want to include your security lead + procurement, feel free to forward the invite or share their emails and I’ll add them.

Proposed invite details:
- Wed 7/22 10:00–10:30am PDT / 1:00–1:30pm EDT
- Agenda: 20 min demo (inc. perf/cost screenshots), 10 min Q&A & next steps

Quick question to tailor the session: are you most interested in (pick one)
- embeddings for semantic search
- chat/assistant for support workflows
- cost/perf optimizations for high-volume endpoints

If you reply with which one, Rachel will focus the demo on that flow.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
